verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's docs describe a retrospectives feature with multiple templates to standardize post-incident reviews. "Draft with AI" analyzes the incident timeline to produce structured drafts with timelines, impacts and lessons learned, and editing is collaborative and integrated with incident data. That covers templates and drafting from the timeline well, but review and publication are only implied by the collaborative editing and permissions docs, and real-time collaboration is Enterprise-only. Missing for 10: explicit review/approval workflow, documented publication/sharing step for finished postmortems, independent hands-on corroboration.
